subject: Mutual Action Plan & Handoff — Nimbus Health sequencing and RACI
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.r@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & Handoff — first-pass sequencing

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the productive discovery call. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a high-level implementation schedule — the goal here is to align milestones, owners, and dates so we can fast-track the sandbox and pilot. Highlights below, and the attachment includes a row-level RACI.

Quick summary (requested items in bold):
- Week 1 (9/6–9/10): Kickoff + environment access
  - Owner: Nimbus IT (Arjun) / Redwood onboarding (Lauren)
  - Ask: VPN & SSO test account details **by 9/3**
- Week 2–3: Data ingestion prototype (sample set)
  - Owner: Nimbus Data Team / Redwood dev (Dev)
  - Ask: delivery of sample export (CSV/NDJSON) **by 9/10**
- Week 4: Pilot evaluation & SLA scoping
  - Owner: Customer Success (Markus) / Nimbus product lead (Sofia)

Attachments: Nimbus_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP with RACI), NH-implementation_schedule.csv (dates/milestones). I also dropped a link to the HubSpot deal in the footer for your procurement team.

Proposed kickoff: Tuesday 9/7 at 10:00am PT. If that works, Lauren will send a calendar invite and agenda. If procurement needs a separate thread, loop them in — happy to sync with Arjun and the procurement contact.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Markus

Hi Markus,

Thanks — this looks good and thorough. 9/7 at 10:00am PT works for our product and IT stakeholders. Two quick notes from our side:

1) Procurement will need the finalized SOW and pricing table before they can issue a PO. I’ve CC’d procurement; procurement will request the SOW and a draft order form (we prefer DocuSign).
2) Arjun will start on the VPN and SSO test accounts; he expects to have a service account ready by Friday 9/3.

We’ll also attach the sample export (small subset) to this thread once Arjun confirms the locations. I’ve asked procurement for a 48-hour turnaround on contract review once they have the SOW.

See you on 9/7.

Best,

Team,

Looping you both so we have a tight internal plan before the external kickoff on 9/7. Action items below (I’ve pulled these from the MAP and the customer replies):

1) SOW draft & pricing table (owner: Monica) — deliver draft SOW + redlines stub to procurement link and to Sofia by EOD 9/4. Attach as SOW_Nimbus_v1.docx.
2) Sandbox provisioning checklist (owner: Lauren) — validate network/route requirements and include runbook for network test on 9/6.
3) Data ingestion prototype (owner: Dev) — review NH-implementation_schedule.csv and prepare an ingestion script template for the sample export. Need sample schema by 9/3, full prototype by 9/17.
4) Kickoff agenda (owner: Markus) — draft and circulate by 9/5; include objectives, success criteria, and decision points.

Risks & mitigations: if procurement delays PO beyond 9/24 we will proceed with demo/pilot on an NDA basis; flag any pricing escalations to me immediately.

Please reply with confirmations and any conflicts. I’ll assemble the internal slide for the kickoff runbook.

Thanks,
Markus
